description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) to change the material used for the car parking facility, to resurface the car park with tarmac following planning permission 00628/A/P26 dated 05/02/2015 for the erection of a single storey side extension and associated changes to the existing car park and landscaping layouts at the foodstore
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission 00628/A/P26 dated 05/02/2015

Condition : 2 - The development shall be completed in the materials specified on the approved plans and within the planning application form, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P(1)09, P(1)08, P(1)07, P(1)06, P(1)05, P(1)04, P(1)03, P(1)02, P(1)01, Planning Statement (December 2013), Design & Access Statement (121150) 6 November 2013, Transport Statement Received 13/12/2013) except where superseded by drawings and specifications 19750-SHE-48-201, 19750-SHE-48-212, Cover letter. Received: 24/11/2023
19750-SHE-48-213(rev.C). Received: 18/01/2024, 6612-0050(rev.E), 6612/01. Received: 29/01/2024

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for food retail  and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the approved plans and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
